reviews.title: Nothing but praise for our crew

items.quote: For over the past ten years, I have used Columbia Tree Service on many occasions for both big and little jobs for my home and business needs and have always had a terrific five star experience. The crew was prompt, professional, knowledgeable and did a wonderful job making my properties look their best. I highly recommend them.
items.name: Scott G.

items.quote: We had 15 very tall & healthy trees cut down around house, power lines & shop. Kris and his crew did an excellent job. They were very knowledgable, very experienced, and extremely respectful to us and our property. We have many seedlings around our property and they didn't damage a single one.
items.name: Larry D.

items.quote: Because of this evaluation and preventive work, we have never experienced trees or their limbs falling during a rain or snow storm. Kris and his crew show up when they are expected, are courteous to the occupants near where they are working, and finish in a timely manner leaving the work area in great shape.
items.name: Jan H., HOA board officer, Hood River

about.photo_alt: Columbia Tree Service bucket trucks set up on a job
about.title: Local tree care since 1992
paragraphs: Columbia Tree Service is a locally owned, professional tree care contractor serving residential and commercial clients in Hood River, The Dalles and the surrounding communities. We've been in business since 1992.

Whether it's tree or hedge trimming, we have the tools and the knowledge to do the job right the first time. We follow the ISA guidelines for tree trimming, so you never have to worry about your trees being incorrectly pruned, and we have a fleet of aerial trucks and climbers for hazard trees over your house.
Owner Kris Zorza is hands-on with every job. Our objective is to provide our customers with the highest quality and fastest service.
